solutionFirstFreeze.conceptAndRole: H15-M1 trigonometric graph; period 4 reduces h to a single shifted sine graph, then extrema on one full period determine the requested expression.
solutionFirstFreeze.periodDerivation: sin(pi*(t+4)/2)=sin(pi*t/2+2*pi)=sin(pi*t/2), so period 4; the coefficient gives exact period 4.
solutionFirstFreeze.uniqueExtrema: On [0,4], sin(pi*u/2)=1 only at u=1 and -1 only at u=3. Thus b=3 at x=a=2 and d=-1 at x=c=4.
